_comment: Numbers shown on the home page that cannot be counted from the repository. Anything countable (articles, talks, newsletter editions) is derived at build time and must not be listed here. A null value is omitted from the page rather than guessed. A value with a 'verified' date older than STATS_MAX_AGE_DAYS fails the build, so a stale claim becomes an error instead of something nobody notices for a year.
